triage_evidence.root_cause:
Go SQLitePriceHistoryRepository.GetHistory at apps/stock-price/pkg/infrastructure/fetchers.go:223-243 — SELECT and Scan parameter order are misaligned:
  Line 224: SELECT date, open, high, low, close, volume
  Line 239: rows.Scan(&c.Date, &c.Low, &c.High, &c.Close, &c.Open, &c.Volume)
  Mapping bug: SQL position 2 (open) → struct.Low; position 4 (low) → struct.Close; position 5 (close) → struct.Open. Only Date/High/Volume are correctly aligned.
